name: resize-handle
title: Resize Handle
description: A large uppercase word cycles through a list, each new one arriving letter by letter, while a thin blue selection rectangle with four square corner handles springs to hug whatever word is showing.
use: A hero title should cycle words to show breadth and you want it framed like editable design-tool text.
avoid: The rotation never stops and cannot be paused; the handles are decorative and do not actually resize anything.
a11y: The words change on a timer with no pause control, and there is no check for reduced motion, so the blur always plays. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A big bold white uppercase word sits centred on a near-black stage, wearing a thin blue rectangle with four small white square handles at its corners. A small letter-spaced grey caption sits above and two lines of muted grey text below.
behaves: Every couple of seconds the word swaps: the old one blurs up and out letter by letter while the new one rises in from below, also letter by letter. The blue box and its handles spring wider or narrower to fit each new word.
customise: The word list and the seconds between flips are props; the blue colour, handle size, font and easing live in the source and need editing.
weight: light: One headline and four small handles; a few framer-motion tweens per word change.
